```artifact
Feature: Self-Test
  As a user
  I want to run the self-test
  So that I can validate the flow sensor accuracy and pressure sensor accuracy

  Scenario: Pre-test mode
    Given the controller is in pre-test mode
    When the GUI is opened
    Then the pre-test mode is displayed

  Scenario: Flow sensor accuracy
    Given the blower is set to 50% speed
    And the air lines are open
    And nothing is connected to the output
    When the self-test is run
    Then the flow rate is 5.0 liters per minute

  Scenario: Pressure sensor accuracy
    Given the pressure sensor is calibrated
    When the self-test is run
    Then the pressure reading is 1013 mbar

  Scenario Outline: Pre-test mode checks
    Given the controller is in pre-test mode
    When the self-test is run
    Then the following checks are performed:
      | Check        | Expected Result |
      | Flow sensor  | 5.0 liters per minute |
      | Pressure sensor | 1013 mbar |

    Examples:
      | Check        | Expected Result |
      | Flow sensor  | 5.0 liters per minute |
      | Pressure sensor | 1013 mbar |

  Scenario: Invalid pre-test mode
    Given the controller is not in pre-test mode
    When the self-test is run
    Then an error message is displayed

  Scenario Outline: Boundary values
    Given the blower speed is <speed>
    And the air lines are open
    And nothing is connected to the output
    When the self-test is run
    Then the flow rate is <flow_rate>

    Examples:
      | speed | flow_rate |
      | 0%    | 0.0 liters per minute |
      | 50%   | 5.0 liters per minute |
      | 100%  | 10.0 liters per minute |

  Scenario Outline: Invalid flow sensor accuracy
    Given the blower is set to <speed>
    And the air lines are open
    And nothing is connected to the output
    When the self-test is run
    Then an error message is displayed

    Examples:
      | speed | flow_rate |
      | 0%    | 0.0 liters per minute |
      | 50%   | 5.0 liters per minute |
      | 100%  | 10.0 liters per minute |
```
